newsitem.title: USA: Charter One to take $0.77/shr Q3 charge.
newsitem.headline: Charter One to take $0.77/shr Q3 charge.

text.p: Charter One Financial Inc said on Monday it would have an after-tax charge of about $37 million or $0.77 per share in the third quarter, to recapitalize the Savings Association Insurance Fund.

New U.S. legislation required banks with Savings Association Insurance Funds to make a one-time payment to replenish the fund and contained a provision which reduced deposit premiums on SAIF-insured deposits.

Based on deposit levels and considering costs to fund the one-time assessment, Charter said it estimated annual after-tax savings would be about $0.13 per share through 1999. Deposit insurance costs would be cut starting January 1997.
The legislation also included more reductions beginning in 2000, if certain conditions were met, Charter said.
Charter One Financial is the holding company for Charter One Bank.
